items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: I played a jam session with him, Rolf and I, and the Japanese drummer who was here before.

ctx.x: Clive said he sounds like album one and he talks about J.J. Johnson.
Yeah, he likes that kind of his life. I played a jam session with him, Rolf and I, and the Japanese drummer who was here before.
